retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s studio portrait layout featuring a central subject in patterned attire with a mix of handwritten script and condensed block typography.
triggerTerms: vintage record cover layout with signature
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is requested
minimalist Swiss style layouts are needed
grunge or distressed textures are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up studio portrait of a man with styled hair, wearing a high-contrast patterned jacket, set against a warm neutral background. The composition is balanced by right-aligned typography including a prominent cursive signature and a list of tracks in a condensed sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the viewer creates immediate engagement.
The busy houndstooth pattern of the jacket contrasts with the smooth skin tones and soft background.
The diagonal orientation of the script signature breaks the verticality of the text block.
Warm, golden-hour studio lighting provides soft modeling on the face.
coreInvariants: High-contrast small-scale geometric pattern on clothing
Right-aligned text block in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark tie provide central focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves to the signature in the top right, then descends through the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus neutral space in the upper left and right corners provides room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white (houndstooth pattern and tie)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the clothing patterns.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or highly saturated primary colors
Stick to earth tones and muted pastels

letterConstructionRules: Script text should mimic fluid, fountain-pen handwriting with varying line weights.
Block text must be strictly vertical, highly condensed, and all-caps.
Uniform stroke width for the block text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'B' and 'N' feature large, expressive loops.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, expressive script and rigid, industrial condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold block caps for the tracklist.
Captures the mid-century brush-script feel of the signature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a 1960s pompadour hairstyle wearing a black and white houndstooth blazer, white shirt, and dark tie. Use warm, soft studio lighting against a tan, slightly textured wall. Leave the upper right quadrant clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, black, hand-written style signature at a 15-degree upward angle in the top right. Below it, add a list of 6 short phrases in white, bold, extra-condensed sans-serif, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the jacket pattern a clear, small-scale houndstooth?
Is the signature angled upwards to the right?
Is the tracklist text strictly right-aligned and condensed?
Is the lighting warm and reminiscent of 1960s film photography?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top right corner
The specific name and track titles
The exact facial features of the celebrity

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color grading
Clean, legible typography despite the busy jacket pattern
avoid: Generic default fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the houndstooth pattern does not create moiré effects.
Verify the script text looks like ink on paper, not a digital font.
Check that the right-alignment of the text block is consistent.
Confirm the subject's expression is neutral yet engaging.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Houndstooth Blazer + Right-Aligned Mixed Typography (Script/Condensed Sans) + Warm Vintage Palette.
